situations.title: 앙와위 정렬
situations.tagline: Let's get him supine and lined up straight before we drape.
keyPhrases: Let's make sure his spine is in neutral alignment.
Head, shoulders, and hips all lined up straight?
Check that his heels aren't hanging off the edge.

situations.title: 안전대 고정 적용
situations.tagline: I'll place the safety strap two fingers above the knees — can you hold his leg?
keyPhrases: The safety strap goes about two inches above the knees.
Make sure it's snug but not too tight.
Can you slip two fingers under the strap?

situations.title: 팔 받침대 각도
situations.tagline: Let's keep his arm boards under ninety degrees to protect the brachial plexus.
keyPhrases: Keep the arm abducted less than ninety degrees.
Palm up, so the arm is in a neutral position.
That protects the brachial plexus from stretch.
goals: 손바닥을 위로 한 중립 자세로 신경을 보호한다

situations.title: 발꿈치 압력 완화
situations.tagline: Let's float his heels on a pillow so they're off the table completely.
keyPhrases: Let's float the heels off the mattress.
Place a pillow under the calves, not the heels.
Check that there's no pressure on the bony points.

situations.title: 체위 변경 팀 조율
situations.tagline: On my count, we'll roll him together — everybody ready?
situations.brief: 체위 변경 시 팀 이동을 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: Let's move on my count — one, two, three.
Who's watching the airway and the lines?
Everyone ready before we roll?
goals: 이동 전 기도와 라인 담당을 확인한다

situations.title: 유도 후 체위 확인
situations.tagline: Now that he's under, let's recheck his alignment and all the pressure points.
situations.brief: 마취 유도 후 체위와 정렬을 다시 확인하세요.
keyPhrases: Now that he's asleep, let's recheck his positioning.
Are his arms still in neutral and well padded?
Let's confirm nothing shifted during induction.

situations.title: 복와위 준비
situations.tagline: Let's set up the prone frame and get our chest rolls ready before we flip him.
keyPhrases: Let's position the chest rolls to keep the abdomen free.
We need enough hands before we flip him prone.
Protect the face and eyes with proper padding.

situations.title: 쇄석위 다리 거치
situations.tagline: Let's raise both legs into the stirrups at the same time to protect his hips.
keyPhrases: Raise both legs into the stirrups together.
Keep the hips flexed but not over-rotated.
Watch the peroneal nerve against the stirrup post.
goals: 양 다리를 동시에 거상해 고관절을 보호한다

situations.title: 측와위 고정
situations.tagline: Let's secure him in the lateral position with the axillary roll placed correctly.
keyPhrases: Place the axillary roll just below the down shoulder.
Secure him with a bean bag and check the pressure points.
Make sure the down arm isn't compressed.
goals: 측와위 고정과 axillary roll을 올바르게 배치한다

situations.title: 트렌델렌버그 안전
situations.tagline: Before we go steep Trendelenburg, let's confirm he won't slide on the table.
keyPhrases: Let's check the anti-slip pad is under him.
Confirm he's secured before we tilt the table down.
Watch his shoulders — no pressure on the braces.

situations.title: 비만 환자 체위 지지
situations.tagline: He's a big guy — let's get extra hands and the right supports before we position him.
keyPhrases: Let's get extra staff before we move him.
We need bariatric-rated supports and straps.
Distribute his weight to protect the pressure points.

situations.title: 체위 변경 관·라인 보호
situations.tagline: Before we turn him, who's got the ET tube and who's got the IV lines?
situations.brief: 체위 변경 시 관과 라인을 보호하세요.
keyPhrases: Who's securing the airway during the turn?
Watch the IV lines and the Foley so nothing pulls.
Call out if any line gets tight.
goals: 이동 전 기도와 라인 담당을 분담한다
이동 중 관 이탈과 당김을 방지한다

situations.title: 압력점 패딩
situations.tagline: Let's pad the elbows, heels, and any bony point before the drapes go on.
keyPhrases: Let's pad every bony prominence.
Check the elbows, heels, and the sacrum.
Make sure the padding stays in place.

situations.title: 관절 과신전 방지
situations.tagline: Let's make sure his shoulder and neck aren't over-extended in this position.
keyPhrases: Keep the joints in a natural, neutral range.
The neck and shoulder shouldn't be over-extended.
Support the limb so it doesn't hang.

situations.title: 장시간 수술 체위 재점검
situations.tagline: We've been going a few hours now — let's recheck the pressure points and padding.
situations.brief: 장시간 수술에서 체위와 압력점을 주기적으로 재점검하세요.
keyPhrases: It's been a while — let's reassess the pressure points.
Any redness or shifting we should correct?
I'll document the position check.

situations.title: 체위 변경 중 활력 급강하
situations.tagline: His pressure just dropped hard after we repositioned — let's level the table and check.
situations.brief: 체위 변경 후 활력이 급강하한 환자에게 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: His blood pressure dropped right after the position change.
Let's bring the table back to neutral.
I'll grab fluids and let anesthesia know.

situations.title: 쇄석위 구획증후군 위험
situations.tagline: His legs have been up in stirrups for hours — I'm worried about compartment syndrome.
situations.brief: 장시간 쇄석위 환자의 구획증후군 위험을 감시하고 보고하세요.
keyPhrases: His legs have been elevated for a long time now.
Let's check the calves for tightness and swelling.
I'm concerned about compartment syndrome — let's lower the legs.
goals: 장시간 거상에 따른 구획증후군 위험을 감시한다

situations.title: 복와위 기도 이탈
situations.tagline: The tube shifted while he's prone — his sats are dropping, I need help now.
situations.brief: 복와위에서 기도가 이탈한 환자에게 응급 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: The airway looks displaced and his sats are falling.
I need everyone to help stabilize the head.
Be ready to turn him supine if we lose the airway.
goals: 응급 인력을 소집하고 필요 시 앙와위 전환을 준비한다

situations.title: 이동 중 낙상 위험
situations.tagline: He's sedated and sliding toward the edge — grab that side before he falls.
keyPhrases: Watch that side — he's sliding toward the edge.
Don't move until we all have a firm hold.
Lock the bed and the table before we transfer.
goals: 이동 중 낙상 위험을 즉시 차단한다

situations.title: 급성 신경 압박 발견
situations.tagline: His arm slipped off the board and it's been compressed — let's reposition it now.
situations.brief: 급성 신경 압박을 발견해 즉시 완화하세요.
keyPhrases: His arm has been compressed against the rail.
Let's reposition it to neutral right away.
We'll document this and watch for nerve signs.

situations.title: 척추 손상 주의 이동
situations.tagline: He's got a possible spine injury — we log-roll as one unit on my count.
situations.brief: 척추 손상이 의심되는 환자를 보호하며 이동하세요.
keyPhrases: We'll log-roll him as one unit to protect the spine.
Keep his head, neck, and spine in line.
Move only on my count.
